Tata Sons AGM Adjourned Amidst Board Division Over Chairman's Future

The Tata Sons Annual General Meeting (AGM) was adjourned, with reports indicating a quorum crisis and a divided board. The meeting was expected to be adjourned and potentially reconvened in mid-September. Disagreements reportedly exist among board members regarding the reappointment of Chairman N Chandrasekaran, whose term ends in February 2027. While some directors are urging him to reconsider his position, the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) has reportedly pushed for the company to search for a successor.
